data_fields.name: stance_weights_attack
data_fields.donor_constant: distance 0.20, angle 0.10, enemy-in-combat 0.10, enemy HP loss 0.15, own HP 0.15, own aggression 0.30 (melee); ranged 0.25/0.05/0.20/0.10/0.40

data_fields.name: damage_margin_scale
data_fields.donor_constant: margin capped at 30; damage = (min(margin,30)*100/60 + 50)% of weapon damage (50%..100%)

best_idea: Each tick the attacker scores attack, cover and flee from weighted terms on distance, angle, both HP and aggression, takes the highest with fixed tie rules, and a landed hit scales its damage by the margin under the hit chance.
decision_why: The weighted stance chooser and the margin-scaled damage fit a per-tick AI brain in src/fight and give readable, testable numbers; the frame-keyed hit roll, the walk-to-waypoint cover and flee, and the single enemy id do not fit a fixed-step server with MAX_ATTACKERS = 3, so keep the scoring and drop the coupling.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a fixed input table (distance, angle, both HP, aggression, speed, cover and flee availability) gives the donor's stance, hit chance and damage; in play a wounded, low-aggression group member takes cover or flees when a cover or flee point exists, and a healthy one stays on the attack.
